paragraphs.text: There are 96 plots on the site and 14 people on the waiting list. The water supply is turned on again on 1 April. The spring work party will be held on Saturday 22 March, starting at 9 am.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Plot rent rises to £38 this year. Members who bring a bag of their own compost to the work party receive a free packet of seeds. The shed key costs £4 and can be collected from the secretary on Sundays.
paragraphs.label: B

items.prompt: How many plots are there on the site?
When is the water turned on?
How much is the plot rent this year?
On which day can the shed key be collected?

groups.instruction: Questions 1–4. Find the answer in the text. You have 20 seconds for each question. Choose NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from the text for each answer.
